Drafting answers to Alice's questions below; happy for you to send once you sign off. I've attached the SOC 2 Type II (2025) attestation stub and an excerpt from our incident response playbook that speaks to notification timelines and escalations. Key points for the email:

- Vendor questionnaire: We don't currently use a vendor portal; we can ingest standard questionnaires (spreadsheet or Doc) and provide responses within 5 business days for a standard SIG-lite/RFI. For more detailed questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ), turnaround may be 7–10 business days.

Hi Alice / security team —

Thanks again for the helpful call and for outlining FintechCorp's requirements. Per Marissa's notes, attaching our SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short excerpt from our incident response playbook. Below are the answers to the specific questions you raised: 

1) SOC 2 coverage: Our SOC 2 Type II report (report date: 2025-11-10) covers our hosted production inference environment (production API endpoints). Attached: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (attestation stub). If you need the full report under NDA, we can provide that via secure share.

2) Breach notification timelines / IR support:
- Detection -> initial business contact notification: within 24 hours of confirmed detection (initial summary).
- Confirmed customer-impacting breach -> customer notification: within 72 hours of confirmation (we commit to timely, coordinated notifications and will provide a post-incident report with technical details and timelines).
- Regulatory reporting (GDPR): we will work with your privacy/contact to provide evidence and support regulatory filings; we will hand over required logs/artifacts in a secure manner.

3) BCP / DR evidence:
- RTO: 2 hours for control-plane failover in our hosted deployment.
- RPO: up to 15 minutes for state/KV cache replication across primary/secondary clusters.
- We run quarterly failover tests and can provide test summaries and runbook excerpts (attached: incident_response_playbook_excerpt.pdf).

4) Vendor questionnaire / intake:
- Primary contact for questionnaire responses: marissa.cole@redwood.com (Security & Compliance).
- Vendor intake link (captures contact + file upload): https://forms.gle/fintech-vendor-questionnaire
- Expected turnaround: 3–5 business days for a standard RFI/SIG-lite; 7–10 business days for full SIG/CAIQs.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (attestation stub), incident_response_playbook_excerpt.pdf (IR timelines & test summary). I've also attached a text file with the vendor questionnaire intake link (vendor_security_questionnaire-link.txt).

If you'd like to schedule a 30-min walkthrough of the questionnaire with Marissa and me next week, I have availability Mon 3/29 10:00–11:30 PT and Tue 3/30 10:00–12:00 PT.

Looking forward to next steps.
